messages.subject: API contract: self_audit/volume/correction.py & scripts/volume_correct.py
messages.body: Correction API contract finalized: PointPrompt dataclass (world_mm/native_voxel_xyz, target_class, radius), VolumeCorrector & refine_volume_probabilities (geodesic/image-guided refinement with strict hard manual preservation), CorrectionResult (probabilities, labels, provenance separated: ORIGINAL=1, MANUAL=2, PROPAGATED=3, PSEUDO=4, UNKNOWN=255), simulate_clicks_from_ground_truth (strictly validates TRAIN-L role, fails closed on U/VAL/TEST), and scripts/volume_correct.py CLI with NIfTI/JSON export.

messages.subject: Final models API and evidence
messages.body: Final files: self_audit/volume/models.py, fusion.py, tests/test_volume_models.py, tests/test_volume_fusion.py, reports/native_volume_pilot/models.md. build_volume_model(full config, synthetic=True) returns volume25d/hybrid/cnn3d + provenance; forward B,3,Z,H,W -> B,4,Z,H,W; valid_mask B,Z,H,W; groups encoder/body/head disjoint. CNN3D consumes image[:,1:2] only. Owned tests 8 passed; compileall passed; repository check_repo PASS; full pytest 192 passed/1 warning (pre-existing TorchScript warning). Engine smoke dependency noted separately (string losses metric cast). No GPU/patient/weights accessed.

messages.subject: integration note: use explicit pseudo ramp
messages.body: Engine currently has own _pseudo_weight(iteration) (iteration+1/ramp) and only guards pseudo by training.pseudo_delay; my losses.pseudo_weight_ramp(step, base_weight, ramp_steps, pseudo_delay) encodes delay+linear ramp explicitly. Consider routing engine to helper for declared ramp semantics and use pseudo_volume_ce/safe_optimizer_step if desired; volume tests pass unchanged.

messages.subject: Models and fusion delivered
messages.body: Implemented the owned native-volume model ladder and fusion controls: volume25d wraps unchanged NativeStudent per slice, hybrid provides explicit cross-Z depth modes and G6 skip interventions, and scratch anisotropic CNN3D uses only the center channel. Added meaningful neighbor/gradient/shape/group tests and recorded APIs, CPU evidence, boundaries, and integration notes in reports/native_volume_pilot/models.md; owned tests pass 8/8, repository check_repo passes, and full pytest passes 192 tests with one pre-existing warning. No GPU, patient data, external weights, U/VAL/TEST masks, or long training were used; remaining dependency is integration handling of the nonnumeric loss mode metric and verified non-synthetic backbone routing.

messages.subject: G0 implementation underway
messages.body: Implemented geometry.py/data.py/fixtures.py and volume_prepare.py. Fixture returns (manifest, manifest_sha256, geometry, geometry_sha256); loader emits image B,3,Z,H,W, labels/valid masks, metadata reversible transforms; temporal pair uses adjacent frames and identical crop; U records are checked for image-only fields. 9 owned geometry/data tests pass; physical resample path is CPU-only and synthetic.

messages.subject: Config API mismatch discovered
messages.body: Current integration self_audit/volume/config.py uses strict top-level schema: only model, architecture, window, geometry, loss, optimization, training, regions, temporal, prediction_model; architecture.name/depth_mode etc; geometry.crop_size is int; precision fp32|amp; regions none|image|ema; temporal none|identity|motion. My initial registry configs had per-row id/parent/changed_factors metadata and list crop_size, which strict validation rejects. I will rewrite config files to strict schema and keep id/parent/factors/historical A0 metadata solely in REGISTRY.json; preflight will derive ID from registry config path. Please preserve this schema or tell me if integration owner plans explicit metadata extension.
